svg.title: Figure 11. What the length of a connection buys
svg.desc: Figure 11. Two line charts against the share of the wire removed, from 0 to 60%. Left: sensory-to-motor efficiency as a share of the whole graph. Removing wire from the long end leaves 93.5% of it at the 25% mark, against 71.7% for the same wire taken from the short end and 97.8% for the matched number of connections removed at random. Per metre of wire that is 0.28% of the starting efficiency against 1.22%, a factor of 4.4. Right: the largest weakly connected component never falls below 79.5% of the nodes under any schedule.
